content.snl: variable(__list__(Type.annotation(@$\mathbb{K}$,Type),LA.Field($\mathbb{K}$),Type.annotation(@M,Type),Type.annotation(@N,Type),Type.annotation(@ι,Type),LA.VectorSpace(M,$\mathbb{K}$),LA.VectorSpace(N,$\mathbb{K}$)),structure(AlternatingMap($\mathbb{K}$,M,N,ι),__enum__(member[colon](%多重线性%,$M^{\iota} \to_{\mathrm{lin}} N$),member[colon](%交错%,$\forall v\ i\ j,\ v_i = v_j \to i \ne j \to \omega(v) = 0$))))

values.zh-CN: `AlternatingMap R M N ι` 是**类型构造子**（结构），记法 $M\,[\bigwedge^{\iota}]\to_{\mathrm{lin}}[R]\,N$：它把 $\iota\to M$ 映到 $N$，对每个变量线性，且任意两个变量取相同值时为零。显式参数依次为 $R\ M\ N\ \iota$——索引类型 $\iota$ 是第四个类型参数，不是某个关于族的谓词参数。
values.en: `AlternatingMap R M N ι` is a **type constructor** (structure), written $M\,[\bigwedge^{\iota}]\to_{\mathrm{lin}}[R]\,N$: it maps $\iota\to M$ to $N$, is linear in every variable, and vanishes when two arguments coincide. Explicit parameters are $R\ M\ N\ \iota$ — the index type is the fourth type parameter, not a predicate argument on a family.
